description: This file contains bindings for Python to interact with C++ classes related to distributed tensor placement, including class definitions, method bindings, and serialization logic for Placement and its subclasses.

classes.name: Placement
classes.description: Base class for different tensor placement strategies in distributed computing.

classes.name: Shard
classes.description: Represents a shard placement of a tensor along a specific dimension.

classes.name: StridedShard
classes.description: Represents a strided shard placement with a split factor.

classes.name: Replicate
classes.description: Represents a replicated placement of a tensor.

classes.name: Partial
classes.description: Represents a partial placement with an optional reduction operation.

methods.name: initPlacementBindings
methods.description: Initializes Python bindings for Placement and its subclasses, defining their constructors, methods, and pickling support.
